completeAcceptanceExpectations.premise: Each of the seven actual current class candidates listed in ACQ04-01 is offered as the class-rage grant.
completeAcceptanceExpectations.expected: CONTRADICTED as a claimed qualifying source: none grants the required operative state. Preserve every original and the unused OR branch.

completeAcceptanceExpectations.premise: Actual source-qualified berserker acquired with CON15 and its own paid opportunity; a later separately payable opportunity and CON15 are evidenced.
completeAcceptanceExpectations.expected: Parent alternative qualifies; no rage need currently be active. This predicate result is not a complete-build approval or a new grant.

completeAcceptanceExpectations.premise: Only berserker_rage/CF-03 is owned or active, or only Frenzied Rage's proposed future benefit is supplied.
completeAcceptanceExpectations.expected: Acquisition does not qualify. When Frenzied Rage has a separately lawful prior acquisition, CF-03 retains its already specified operating interaction.

completeAcceptanceExpectations.premise: Isolated mock external class source expressly grants a rage state and a bound mock grant assigns it to the actor before acquisition with its source gates.
completeAcceptanceExpectations.expected: CONDITIONAL_ONLY exercises the preserved class OR branch. No mock class/card enters the current catalog. A source without actor assignment is UNESTABLISHED.

completeAcceptanceExpectations.premise: Opaque conditional deity reference, source-linked worship relationship for this actor/world, effective at acquisition, scoped mock authority, CHA15 and a separate payable opportunity.
completeAcceptanceExpectations.expected: CONDITIONAL_ONLY for the external predicate. No deity is named, invented as current content, or authenticated by the fixture.

completeAcceptanceExpectations.premise: File exists or a deity reference exists, but no actor worship relationship; alternatively the relationship is shown ended before acquisition.
completeAcceptanceExpectations.expected: The first is UNESTABLISHED; the ended-at-snapshot relationship is CONTRADICTED. No extra favor award, ritual or minimum-duration requirement is introduced.

completeAcceptanceExpectations.premise: Opaque conditional prior exposure event identifies this actor/world and the literal required plane predicate; choose one existing allowed permanent damage type.
completeAcceptanceExpectations.expected: CONDITIONAL_ONLY. No present exposure or type-to-plane match is added. The choice remains separate from event authentication.

completeAcceptanceExpectations.premise: Only elemental damage, resistance, class/ancestry name, or a generic visit is supplied without the literal source-qualified exposure fact.
completeAcceptanceExpectations.expected: UNESTABLISHED; these facts cannot be silently converted into the required event.

completeAcceptanceExpectations.premise: Required external fact is consistent, but CHA14 for Divine Favor, CON14 for Elemental Body, or no separate payable opportunity.
completeAcceptanceExpectations.expected: External predicate evidence does not waive the failing independent acquisition gate; acquisition is denied.

completeAcceptanceExpectations.premise: A required reference is absent, null, points nowhere, mismatches its hash/pointer/version, points to another actor/world, or lacks scoped authority.
completeAcceptanceExpectations.expected: UNESTABLISHED for the required credential; preserve distinct raw reasons/absence/null and no grant/payment write. An unrelated valid OR alternative may still qualify.

completeAcceptanceExpectations.premise: Supporting event/grant occurs after acquisition, or at the same time without an earlier authoritative order; compare with a real earlier sequence at that timestamp.
completeAcceptanceExpectations.expected: Later/unordered evidence cannot establish the prior predicate; the genuinely earlier sequence may pass chronology. No extra elapsed-time delay is invented.

completeAcceptanceExpectations.premise: Current Drakari, Mage, feat-only Sorcerer curriculum, Draconic literacy or an unbound Sorcerer label is offered as the qualifying branch.
completeAcceptanceExpectations.expected: No current alias qualifies. Preserve source trees, curricula and both printed Dragon Blood alternatives.

completeAcceptanceExpectations.premise: An isolated hypothetical legacy Dragonborn source plus actual mock actor lineage assignment and one source-bound damage type.
completeAcceptanceExpectations.expected: CONDITIONAL_ONLY; removal or mismatch of the linked damage type/lineage evidence makes the predicate UNESTABLISHED. No new builder lineage.

completeAcceptanceExpectations.premise: An isolated hypothetical legacy Sorcerer class source/actor grant at class level1+, its actual mock draconic-bloodline grant and one linked damage type.
completeAcceptanceExpectations.expected: CONDITIONAL_ONLY. Missing either class or bloodline fails that AND branch. Type from another character/lineage is not usable. No new class option.

completeAcceptanceExpectations.premise: A valid conditional fixture is relabeled/mixed into a campaign snapshot or a Boolean eligible result loses its conditional provenance.
completeAcceptanceExpectations.expected: Reject as actual acquisition evidence; only CONDITIONAL_ONLY is possible within the admitted fixture domain. Byte hashes do not authenticate campaign history.

completeAcceptanceExpectations.premise: Apply the finite shared append/policy references and render the corresponding current mirrors; compare all existing fields and histories.
completeAcceptanceExpectations.expected: All four originalObject/printedPrerequisite/requirements/completeOperativeProcedure values, all other contracts, class/ancestry/supplement objects, ACQ01-03 text, deferred payloads and all approval/selection flags remain unchanged. Only the named additions are permitted.

limits: All admitted roots are explicitly conditional fixtures. No actual campaign positive is supplied, authenticated or promoted; ESTABLISHED_FOR_SNAPSHOT is not claimed as executed positive evidence.
Hypothetical external class, class-feature, lineage and bloodline records exist solely within the audit fixtures. No such option is added to current catalogs or runtime selectors.

The external actor/class assignments are controlled conditional premises, not complete multiclass character builds. Real Warrior ASI/feat payment slices and permanent ability rolls are separately source-derived.
Required source clauses, actor/world/authority bindings, effective chronology, selected-feature history, permanent choices and source-bound damage types are checked; no cosmology meaning is supplied.

CF-03 remains a distinct paid feat whose operating interaction is preserved textually. Rage attacks, durations, charges, elemental damage, resistance and Divine Favor use resolution are not executed here.

The new four-identity count concerns partial prerequisite interfaces, not four complete feat uses, all335 acquisitions or exact candidate approval. Companion Training ownership/body history remains outstanding.
